# Introduction {.unnumbered}

**Unit 5: AI in the Real World**

What AI means for your privacy, your future job, and the news you see.

We will look at real scams, real changes happening at work right now, and have honest conversations about what is coming.

***

## What You'll Learn

By the end of this unit, you will be able to:

* Protect your privacy when you use apps and AI
* Recognize AI scams and help your family stay safe
* Describe how AI is changing jobs right now
* Think about how AI changes the news you see

***

## Topics in This Unit

[**Your Data, Your Privacy**](5.1_Your_Data_Your_Privacy.qmd)\
Data you give, data you leak, and the hidden location inside a photo.

[**AI Scams**](5.2_AI_Scams.qmd)\
The warning signs that still work when AI writes perfect scam messages.

[**AI and Jobs**](5.3_AI_and_Jobs.qmd)\
A job is a bundle of tasks: what AI can do, what it can help with, and what people do.

[**AI and the News**](5.4_AI_and_the_News.qmd)\
How a feed learns what you like, and why your feed is not your friend's.
